title: Impersonation and Identity Creation (SYNTHETIC TEST ONLY)
source_text: Whoever intentionally creates a synthetic profile or online identity using another person's name or likeness without consent commits synthetic impersonation.
plain_language_summary: Creating an online profile using someone else's name or photo without their consent.

legal_elements.description: Creation of profile or online identity
Use of another person's name or likeness

exceptions_or_qualifications: Does not apply to authorized dramatic portrayals or parody.
penalty_text: Synthetic penalty of imprisonment up to 2 years or synthetic fine of 50,000 credits.

title: Non-Consensual Image Uploading (SYNTHETIC TEST ONLY - UNVERIFIED RECORD)
source_text: Whoever transmits or publishes visual images of a person without explicit permission commits synthetic privacy violation.
plain_language_summary: Uploading or transmitting photos of someone without their permission.

title: Digital Financial Extortion (SYNTHETIC TEST ONLY)
source_text: Whoever intentionally demands money or property by threatening to disseminate digital images or private records commits digital extortion.
plain_language_summary: Demanding money by threatening to leak private photos or data.

legal_elements.description: Threatening dissemination of private records or images

penalty_text: Synthetic penalty of imprisonment up to 5 years and synthetic fine.
